notes.title: LOS Pinguinos
notes.notes:
Hello everyone I am very glad to see you all. In the latest update of the game, new mechanics have been added that have made the gameplay even more interesting.

Now you can go in search of fish to replenish your stocks. The new fish-hunting mechanics have added an element of randomness and strategy to the game, as players have to make decisions about how to optimize their resources.

In addition, the update removed doors from the game map, which created new challenges for players. Now they have to look for alternative ways and strategies to achieve their goals.

The LOS pinguinos update has brought new features and challenges to the game that will allow players to immerse themselves even deeper into this atmosphere.
